companySlogan: Benchmark pay, price jobs, build pay ranges, run merit cycles, and communicate total rewards in one end-to-end platform.
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Pave, we're building the industry’s leading compensation platform, combining the world's largest real-time compensation dataset with deep expertise in AI and machine learning. Our platform is perfecting the art and science of pay to give 9,000+ companies unparalleled confidence in every compensation decision.

Top tier companies like OpenAI, McDonald’s, Instacart, Atlassian, Affirm, Ericsson, Synopsys, Stripe, Doordash, Fanatics, Databricks, and Waymo use Pave, transforming every pay decision into a competitive advantage. $190+ billion in total compensation spend is managed in our workflows, and 80% of Forbes AI 50 use Pave to benchmark compensation.

The future of pay is real-time & predictive, and we’re making it happen right now. We’ve raised $175M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Insight Partners, Atomico, Venture Partners, and Craft Ventures.

The Market Pricing Team @ Pave

Compensation decisions get made every day with far less data than they deserve. Market Pricing empowers teams to price jobs in hours instead of months, with more data, build competitive pay ranges, and understand exactly how those decisions land across their organization. Getting this right means companies can stay competitive and retain their best talent.

What You'll Do
  • Propose and implement scalable systems for our most sophisticated customers
  • Partner with stakeholders to take ambiguous problems from an idea to a shipped, enterprise-ready feature
  • Own all phases of the development lifecycle, from a conversation with a customer to post-release monitoring
  • Set technical direction across projects, mentor engineers, and raise the bar on how the team build
What You'll Bring
  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience
  • A strong eye for performance, reliability, and robust systems design
  • You have empathy for compensation teams and understand the challenges involved in pricing an employees’ pay
  • You have strong judgement when operating in the unknown; weighing all of the tradeoffs when there is no “correct” answer
  • Proven ability to break ambiguous, complex problems into concrete milestones with clear success metrics and drive them to completion with minimal oversight
  • You influence design decisions across the team, mentor other engineers, and bring people along through clear reasoning
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments and ship thoughtful solutions without over-engineering
Compensation, It's What We Do.

At Pave, we believe compensation should be as thoughtful as the people we hire. Your total rewards package includes meaningful equity, best-in-class medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited PTO, and region-specific benefits designed around your life, not just your role. Your level and compensation are determined by your experience and how you show up throughout the interview process. We're always happy to walk you through how we think about leveling — just ask.

Targeted cash compensation for this role:
P4: $195,500 - $264,500

Benefits @ Pave

At Pave, growth isn't a perk — it's the point. As you develop, your role expands, your responsibilities deepen, and your compensation reflects the impact you're making.

What we offer
  • Your Health, Fully Covered: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with a range of options designed to meet you where you are.
  • Time That's Actually Yours: Flexible PTO and the freedom to work from anywhere in the world for up to a month — because life doesn't pause, and neither should you.
  • Fuel for the Work: Lunch and dinner stipends plus fully stocked kitchens, so you can stay energized without thinking twice about it.
  • Room to Keep Growing: A quarterly education stipend to invest in the skills and knowledge that matter most to you.
  • Support When It Matters Most: Robust parental leave so you can be fully present for the moments that count.
  • Getting Here, Made Easier: A commuter stipend to support the in-person collaboration that makes great work happen.
Life @ Pave 

Founded in 2019 with a clear purpose and a team that has never wavered from it, Pave has grown into a global force in compensation management — giving thousands of companies the tools to take control, build confidence, and earn credibility in every pay decision they make. And we're just getting started. Headquartered in San Francisco's Financial District, with regional hubs in New York City's Flatiron District, Salt Lake City, Kraków (Poland), and the United Kingdom — wherever you're based, you'll find the same thing: people who genuinely care about the work, each other, and the customers that rely on Pave.

We run a hybrid culture that brings teams together in person 4 days a week — and every Friday, the whole company gathers for our Team Sync: breakfast, new hire welcomes, product updates, fireside chats, and yes, the occasional Kahoot. It's one of the things people notice when they join us — that we truly enjoy spending time together.

Our culture is shaped by five values we live every day:

  • Be Intellectually Honest — Truth over comfort. We face reality clearly and speak directly, even when it's hard.
  • Play to Win — We're not here to participate. We're here to be the #1 compensation platform in the world, and we act like it.
  • Uphold the Pave Platinum Standard — We hold ourselves to the highest bar — for our customers, our data, and each other.
  • One Team — We win and lose together. Titles don't drive decisions here — shared goals do.
  • Hug of Jawn — Hard to define, impossible to miss. Ask your recruiter.

Our Vision: Unlock a labor market built on trust.

Our Mission: Build confidence in every compensation decision.

We build software that transforms how companies pay their people — and we believe the team behind that software deserves the same thoughtfulness. If you're ready to help shape the future of compensation alongside people who are smart, humble, and genuinely motivated by the problem we're solving, we'd love to meet you. 

Still deliberating? Just apply! We're always excited to meet people who are eager to contribute.

Pave uses automated tools, including AI-based fraud detection, to verify applicant identity and protect the integrity of our hiring process.

Who are we looking for?

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer 2 within our Guest and Loyalty Domain. This team drives the systems powering our loyalty program and guest engagement data. As a key contributor, you’ll participate in the full development lifecycle—analyzing complex problems, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping build the future of our platform.

We’re looking for an ambitious and inquisitive engineer, someone who thrives on learning, embraces new technology, and is excited by the opportunity to build impactful systems in a collaborative environment.

If you’re a self-starter who enjoys technology and solving meaningful problems, we invite you to apply today and #MakeItYourChoice.

Your Responsibilities

  • Analyze user stories and develop secure, maintainable Java code with Spring frameworks.
  • Use agentic AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity and code quality.
  • Contribute to design discussions, peer code reviews, and integration testing efforts.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments (AWS).
  • Assist with monitoring and debugging production systems using tools like Prometheus and OpenSearch.
  • Partner closely with QA for validation and test planning.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support production systems.
  • Stay current on new technologies, frameworks, and software development best practices.

Your Experience, Skills & Competencies

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2–4 years of Java (v1.8+) development experience with Spring (REST, MVC, Security).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Experience with collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Source control proficiency – Bitbucket / Git workflows, branching strategies, and merge conflict resolution
  • Comfort using modern Java IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA or Visual Studio Code, and build tools such as Maven or Gradle
  • Understanding of secure coding practices and fundamentals of application security
  • Strong debugging habits and experience working with logs and monitoring tools
  • SQL/relational database fundamentals
  • Good verbal, written, and listening communication skills
  • Good interpersonal skills and demeanor
  • A curious, growth-oriented mindset and an eagerness to explore tools like Copilot, Claude, or other AI-powered developer assistants

Your Team

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager of Software Engineering in the Guest & Loyalty Domain. You’ll be part of a tight-knit, collaborative team of 5–7 engineers, working alongside cross-functional partners in product, QA, and architecture.

  • PLEASE NOTE: This role is not eligible for sponsorship ***

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance

  • Employee recognition programs

Description

Summary:

The Data Mastering Management Services team at Huntington is responsible for delivery of customer data and mastering services that interface with the customer database and present accurate and fit for purpose data to internal colleagues and customers.

In this Mid-level Developer position, the successful candidate will analyze and modify existing software/application programs or may write new programs to support user and management needs. Design, test, debug, document, and implement Java/Spring Boot based programs. Consults with users to design, modify, and explain program changes or to provide technical support. Resolves problems which occur in production systems. Participates in formal and informal training programs.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Designs, tests, debugs, documents, and implements those programs.
  • Consults with users to design, modify, and explain program changes or to provide technical support.
  • Resolves problems which occur in production systems.
  • May serve as project leader in the development of automated systems or procedures.
  • Provides direction and training to other team members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, with hands-on experience developing backend applications.
  • Bachelors Degree


Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on development experience using Java and a solid understanding of object-oriented programming concepts.
  • Experience with Spring Framework and/or Spring Boot.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience using Git or a comparable source-control platform.
  • Understanding of core software-development concepts, including object-oriented programming, data structures, exception handling, and common design principles.
  • Experience with unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting application issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to learn new technologies.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to contribute within a collaborative development team.
  • Experience developing applications using Java 8 or newer.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture or distributed applications.
  • Exposure to a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and automated build/deployment processes using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies.
  • Experience with API development/testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, or OpenAPI.
  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit or Mockito.
  • Exposure to application monitoring, logging, or production-support practices.
  • Experience working in financial services, banking, payments, or a large enterprise technology environment is a plus.


Exempt Status: (Yes = not eligible for overtime pay) (No = eligible for overtime pay)

Yes

Office

Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. Remote roles will also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for moments that matter. Specific work arrangements will be provided by the hiring team.

Huntington will not sponsor applicants for this position for immigration benefits, including but not limited to assisting with obtaining work permission for F-1 students, H-1B professionals, O-1 workers, TN workers, E-3 workers, among other immigration statuses. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

All unsolicited resumes sent to any Huntington colleagues, directly or indirectly, will be considered Huntington property. companyDescription:
Rippling is a workforce management system that eliminates the friction from running a business. Today, most companies struggle with everything from routine tasks, like running payroll, to cross-functional planning, like aligning on headcount. That’s because all their data related to people, processes, and systems is scattered in a hundred places. 

Rippling has every application you need to run your business—from applicant tracking and payroll to IT and expenses—in one place. But unlike other systems, Rippling sits on top of a unified platform. Data flows dynamically between Rippling’s applications, giving every team a shared source of truth, the power to automate processes, and access to the insights they need. This allows your business to execute better, faster.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Platform Team

The Platform Engineering team is the invisible engine that powers all of Rippling's integrated products—HR, IT, and Finance. Our mission is to build the core infrastructure, tools, and shared services that allow every other engineering team to ship highly reliable, secure, and globally scalable features with maximum velocity. We manage the foundational components that ensure Rippling's single, unified platform operates efficiently and securely.

Our Scope: Foundational Systems for 1,000+ Engineers

Operating as a critical scaled team, we own and operate a variety of mission-critical systems that directly support close to 1,000 engineers building products and internal platforms across Rippling. We deliver the most foundational shared systems inside the Platform organization.

What You Will Do

  • Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale.
  • Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance.
  • Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment.
  • Effectively integrate into cross-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback.

What You Will Need

  • 2+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
  • Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs.
  • Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

The pay range for this role is:

152,000 - 225,000 USD per year(US Tier 1)

descriptionHtml:
MyOme is a clinical whole genome analysis company helping individuals and families understand their risk for disease. As a leader in polygenic and AI-based integrative risk modeling, we combine genome sequencing with AI-driven analytics and clinical data to deliver a lifetime of clinically meaningful, actionable insights, from proactive risk assessment to rare disease diagnosis. Our laboratory is CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited, and we’re based in Menlo Park, California.

Our team brings together scientists, engineers, clinicians, and professionals across disciplines, united by a shared purpose: making genomic insight a routine part of everyday healthcare. We put patients first and hold ourselves to the scientific and clinical rigor that families and their clinicians depend on.

Joining MyOme means contributing your expertise to work that matters for patients and families. Whether you’re advancing our science and technology, supporting the clinicians and patients we serve, or strengthening our operations, you’ll help turn genomic discoveries into better care.

Position Overview:

MyOme is looking for an experienced and pragmatic individual to join our integrations and portals team. This position will help enable patients and healthcare providers order testing through the MyOme platform, delivering clarity and meaningful health insights from complex genetics results. The successful candidate will demonstrate first-hand knowledge of designing secure, well-architected applications, familiarity with healthcare systems and data, and have an eagerness to build value through fast prototyping and iteration.

What You'll Do:

  • Add functionality to backend systems to support enhancements of our customer-facing portals
  • Support partners through reusable and extensible feature builds
  • Develop robust APIs that are secure, well-documented, and easy to integrate
  • Debug and solve production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack
  • Leverage AI to assist with planning and implementing solutions
  • Contribute to the team through code reviews, design discussions, and planning future work
  • Collaborate effectively as part of a distributed team
  • Balance quick wins with long-term technical sustainability

What You'll Need:

  • 6+ years of experience in backend or platform software development
  • 2+ years of healthcare/biotech experience
  • Proficient in Python and Python-based frameworks (Django, FastAPI, Ninja)
  • Proven track record of building and deploying production-grade APIs and web applications
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization systems
  • Ability to work with a high level of autonomy and responsibility
  • Performance engineering experience, including instrumentation, profiling, and optimization
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with HIPAA compliance and healthcare software, or other privacy-focused frontends
  • Knowledgeable about genetics and genetic testing platforms

Location, Compensation, and Benefits:

  • Location: Remote in the US or open to hybrid, 2 to 3 days onsite at our San Francisco office.
  • Compensation: Annual salary range of $160,000 - $200,000, commensurate with experience. This role is eligible for equity.

San Francisco Bay Area pay range: $160,000 USD - $200,000 USD

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Health, Dental, and Vision)
  • 401K
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company-sponsored off-sites and team meals during in-person meetings
  • Direct access to company leadership and the opportunity for career growth

MyOme provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and as otherwise required by law. To request an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact hr@myome.com.

  • Want to make an impact at the intersection of healthcare and technology, changing the way people engage with their health at the genetic level
  • Enjoy rolling up your sleeves, taking initiative, and being empowered to lead
  • Value humility, transparency, and collaborative problem-solving

descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Software Developer - Backend, who is curious, ambitious, and eager to make an impact. You'll join a team building cloud-native systems that power our global operations, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how we evolve our platform.


Our stack is .NET based, but we care more about your engineering fundamentals and your drive to learn than checking boxes on specific technologies. If you've built great things in Java, Go, Python, Node, or any other stack and want to grow into .NET, we want to talk to you.


Core Duties

  • Design and build scalable APIs and backend services
  • Model complex business domains and optimize database performance
  • Architect integrations with third-party systems (ERP, payments, tax services)
  • Implement event-driven and message-based architectures
  • Write clean, testable code and champion engineering best practices
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver features that impact our global dealer network
  • Troubleshoot production systems and drive performance improvements
  • Mentor teammates and contribute to technical decision-making
  • Implement state management for complex multi-step processes
  • Create responsive designs that work seamlessly across devices


Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years building backend systems in production environments
  • Strong fundamentals in any modern language (C#, Java, Go, Python, TypeScript, etc.)
  • Deep experience designing and building REST APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and data modeling
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts: service bus, message queues, caching, eventual consistency
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • A track record of shipping software and solving hard problems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Elasticsearch or similar search technologies
  • Exposure to AI/ML powered search, vector databases, or semantic search
  • Experience building fault tolerant systems (retry policies, circuit breakers, graceful degradation)
  • Background in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms
  • Experience with multi region deployments and globally distributed systems
  • Experience with ERP integrations (NetSuite, SAP, etc.)
  • Familiarity with real time systems (WebSockets, SignalR, etc.)
  • Observability and monitoring experience (distributed tracing, structured logging)


XPEL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

descriptionHtml:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

About Us

eSimplicity is a modern digital services company that works across government, partnering with our clients to improve the health and lives of millions of Americans, ensure the security of all Americans—from soldiers and veterans to kids and the elderly, and defend national interests on the battlefield. Our engineers, designers, and strategists cut through complexity to create intuitive products and services that courageously equip Federal agencies with solutions to transform today for a better tomorrow for all Americans.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to design and deliver secure, reliable services for the Department of State’s OPERAS program. You will build and maintain APIs, application services, and integrations supporting online passport experiences. You will work closely with product, design, security, platform, and partner teams to translate requirements into maintainable software and support that software through production.

This role is contingent upon successful Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) suitability determination and award.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations supporting online passport applications and related workflows.
  • Translate product and technical requirements into clear service contracts, data models, implementation plans, and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Integrate with identity, payment, document processing, and other government or partner services, including handling errors, retries, and data validation.
  • Apply secure engineering practices to authentication, authorization, session handling, sensitive data, and application configuration.
  • Write automated tests, conduct code reviews, and improve maintainability, performance, and reliability throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Add useful logging, metrics, and tracing, and collaborate with reliability and support engineers to diagnose and resolve production issues.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, release validation, and approved deployments in collaboration with platform and security teams.
  • Document technical decisions and integration behavior, identify dependencies early, and mentor teammates through implementation and review.

Competencies

  • Backend Design: Creates clear service boundaries, reliable APIs, and maintainable components suited to business and operational needs.
  • Engineering Quality: Balances delivery speed with secure code, meaningful testing, readable implementation, and long-term maintainability.
  • Problem Solving: Investigates complex defects methodically and considers the impact of changes across dependent systems.
  • Technical Ownership: Carries work from requirements through production and addresses issues beyond the immediate code change.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: Explains tradeoffs clearly, provides constructive reviews, and helps teammates build shared understanding.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements. Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability or Public Trust determination.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience in software design and development, including backend services, APIs, and production integrations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or another related scientific or technical discipline. Candidates without a degree must have 10 years of total professional experience, including 8 years of relevant experience required above.
  • Proficiency in a modern backend programming language and framework, relational databases, and SQL.
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs, validating data, managing errors, and integrating with external systems.
  • Experience with automated testing, Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and troubleshooting production software.
  • Knowledge of secure application development, authentication and authorization, and protecting sensitive information.
  • Ability to collaborate in an Agile team and communicate technical decisions, risks, and dependencies to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS, containerized applications, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS.
  • Experience with application observability, performance tuning, and resilient integration patterns.
  • Experience delivering federal digital services in government-owned environments with security and change control requirements.

Working Environment

eSimplicity supports a remote work environment operating within the Eastern time zone so we can work with and respond to our government clients. Expected hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern unless otherwise directed by your manager.

Travel for training and project meetings is expected to be 5% per year.

Benefits

eSimplicity offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement benefits, paid time off, paid holidays, life and disability insurance, and additional wellness and employee support programs. Eligibility may vary based on employment status and applicable plan terms.

Reasonable Accommodation

eSimplicity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process. Applicants who need assistance or an accommodation should contact Human Resources.

Equal Employment Opportunity

eSimplicity is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Salary Description

$90,300 - $140,000

descriptionHtml:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

Senior Software Engineer, Backend

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood’s engineering organization spans Crypto, Brokerage, and Core Engineering, each responsible for systems that are foundational to how customers invest and manage their money! These teams build and operate platforms for trading, custody, ledgers, reporting, payments, and shared infrastructure, with a strong focus on correctness, reliability, and customer trust. Engineers partner closely with product, design, data, and infrastructure teams to deliver software that performs at scale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build large-scale distributed systems that support real-time trading, balances, and platform capabilities. You will lead technically complex projects, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with frontend and data partners to deliver well-structured APIs. Your work will directly influence system performance, operational safety, and long-term maintainability across core Robinhood products.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve scalable backend systems, balancing performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Design, implement, test, and release product-facing features with strict correctness and availability requirements.
  • Partner with frontend and data engineers to define and refine REST APIs that serve millions of customers.
  • Lead large, technically complex projects from design through execution.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on technical guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, developer productivity, and operational risk.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building low-latency, large-scale distributed systems in production environments.
  • Experience designing and operating highly concurrent systems and well-structured REST APIs.
  • Demonstrated ownership of large projects with sustained impact on a system or team.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to prioritize work aligned with business and reliability goals.
  • Ability to break down complex problems and deliver practical, high-quality solutions.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and contributing to technical direction on new initiatives.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)

$196,000—$230,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)

$172,000—$202,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)

$153,000—$179,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities
Global E-commerce is a discovery-driven e-commerce business, working to become a destination for users to discover and buy good products at affordable prices. We build a shopping experience that feels tailored to each user, and a platform merchants can rely on across live and short-video commerce.

TikTok Shop is a more personalized way to shop, where joy, entertainment, and discovery meet. People engage directly with sellers and creators through shoppable videos and interactive livestreams, discovering and buying trending products without leaving the app. We want to be where people find innovative, unique, high-quality products from around the world, in an environment that stays safe and secure for sellers, creators, and users alike.

You will help redefine how people discover, search, and shop for the things they love, on a business expanding quickly across global markets.

The Global E-commerce Seller Business team plays a critical role in driving the success of our Global E-commerce platform. We are dedicated to building and nurturing a thriving ecosystem of local and global sellers who bring diverse products, brands, and innovations to our marketplace.
Our engineering team builds scalable systems and platform capabilities that support sellers throughout their journey on TikTok Shop, including onboarding, product management, order and fulfillment experiences, customer service, seller growth, and other core commerce capabilities.

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services and systems supporting key e-commerce and seller experiences.
- Build reliable APIs and distributed systems supporting high-volume commerce workflows, data processing, and platform capabilities.
- Develop and improve technical solutions across areas such as seller onboarding, product and catalog management, orders, fulfillment, customer service, and seller growth.
- Improve system scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and operational stability for large-scale e-commerce services.
- Troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed services and production environments and develop scalable, long-term solutions.
- Partner with Product, Operations, and other engineering teams to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions that improve seller experience and platform adoption.
- Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver platform capabilities supporting TikTok Shop's international growth.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 3+ years of experience developing highly scalable backend services and systems using at least one programming language such as Java, Golang, Python, Scala, or C++.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, and scalable system design.
- Experience building backend services, distributed systems, APIs, or other high-availability online systems.
- Strong programming capabilities with good code design and coding practices.
- Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams.
- Strong product and business understanding, with the ability to align engineering solutions with current and future business needs.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, seller platforms, merchant services, payments, SaaS, or other complex business platforms.
- Experience building seller- or merchant-facing systems, commerce infrastructure, or high-scale transactional platforms.
- Understanding of observability, reliability, data consistency, and performance optimization for large-scale distributed systems.
- Experience working with APIs, platform services, or third-party systems.
- Familiarity with modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and developer productivity tooling.
- Passion for programming, strong learning ability, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive mindset toward emerging technologies.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​


Job Information
【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)
The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $153900 - $300960 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

companyDescription:
Dataminr has created a revolutionary AI platform for discovering real-time events, risks, and threats in public data, providing global organizations and corporations with critical and actionable information. Its pioneering multi-modal fusion AI pulls from more than one million unique public data sources to synthesize terabytes of data spanning text, image, video, audio, and sensor signals for accurate, real-time event detection across 150+ languages and 220+ countries and territories. Dataminr pushes the boundaries of real-time information with ReGenAI -- an innovation that combines Predictive AI and Generative AI to describe breaking events and provide dynamic re-generating updates to events as they unfold. Powered by more than 50 proprietary large-language models, Dataminr delivers the earliest actionable information to enhance the security and resilience of organizations, infrastructure, and people. 

Dataminr is making its mark for growth and innovation, earning multi-year recognition on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Forbes AI 50, Forbes Cloud 100, and Built In Best Places to Work lists.

We are creating a team of talented builders, creators and visionaries to have a real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Join our team and help the world manage risk in real time. You’ll work with 500+ talented people across ten global offices, united by our passion to collaborate, make a difference, and have fun while doing it!
companySlogan: The Leading AI Platform for Real-time Information and Event Discovery
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Dataminr is the global leader in AI-powered real-time event, threat & risk intelligence, and the pioneer of Autonomous Real-Time Intelligence (ARI). Our mission-critical platform delivers the earliest warning on breaking events and emerging risks across physical, digital, and cyber domains, so people can act quickly with confidence. We didn’t join the AI wave. We built it.

Founded in 2009, Dataminr is trusted by more than two-thirds of the Fortune 50, half of the Fortune 100, 100+ U.S. government agencies, and 20+ international governments to protect people, assets, and operations.

Join our mission-driven team of 700+ builders, creators, and visionaries across nine global offices, united by a passion to use AI for the greater good.

About The Opportunity

As a Software Engineer III, Backend, you’ll join a fast-moving product engineering team building the future of our customer platform. You’ll ship code to production from day one, take ownership of multiple microservices, and design significant features that span several services, all within a modern, distributed application that ingests and processes hundreds of thousands of data points every second. You’ll also help shape the next generation of our architecture, raising the bar for engineering excellence as we deliver critical alerts to our clients faster and with near-perfect reliability. This is a US based position that can be remote or based out of our NYC office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ship code to production from day one and see your work make an immediate impact
  • Take ownership of multiple microservices, and design and deliver significant features that span several services
  • Shape the next generation of our architecture as we deliver more alerts to clients faster and with near-perfect reliability
  • Design and develop SQL-based databases that power performant, scalable data solutions
  • Build secure, seamless access experiences by implementing identity and access management with OAuth, Okta, and similar technologies
  • Raise the bar for engineering excellence by applying industry best practices alongside novel patterns and technologies that strengthen our codebase and product
  • Partner with talented teammates to plan and deliver the next iteration of our customer applications, supporting emerging use cases

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable back end services and applications
  • Proficiency in Java, Scala, Python, or other object-oriented languages, with hands-on experience in microservices, distributed systems, and real-time streaming data
  • Strong skills in object-oriented design, API design, data modeling, and coding, backed by a solid grasp of data structures and algorithms
  • Experience with SQL-based database development
  • Familiarity with identity and access management, including OAuth, Okta, or similar technologies
  • A proven track record of championing strong engineering practices through hands-on coding
  • We’re AI-first: you’ll design AI-assisted workflows, build reusable prompts, and share what you learn.

We offer a competitive benefits package aimed at keeping you healthy and happy:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plan options for employees, domestic partners and their dependents
  • Generous PTO / flexible sick days
  • Paid parental leave and family forming benefits
  • Mental health benefits and support
  • Company equity (RSUs)

Join Our Global Team

At Dataminr, we serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the diversity of the world in which we live. At Dataminr we actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, learning and development funds, and more. Dataminr is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Individuals seeking employment at Dataminr are considered without regards to race, sex, color, creed, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetics, marital status, pregnancy, unemployment status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status.

The annual base salary range for this position is $120,800 - $177,500. You will also be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus and Company equity. Actual salary will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, applicant skills, and prior relevant experience.

Dataminr will collect and process your personal data in accordance with Dataminr’s candidate privacy notice available here. By providing your details and applying via our careers website, you acknowledge that you have read our candidate privacy notice. If you have any queries, please contact recruiting@dataminr.com or privacy@dataminr.com.

descriptionHtml:
At Tessera Labs, we’re revolutionizing business process automation with cutting-edge AI technology. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world-class founding team, we’re building a high-impact engineering group to bring AI-powered automation to the enterprise world.

Our multi-agent AI systems transform complex business workflows—eliminating inefficiencies, optimizing operations, and enabling seamless integrations across platforms like SAP, Salesforce, and Workday. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build at the bleeding edge of AI.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer (Mid-Level) who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment. You’ll help design, build, and maintain the backend systems that power Tessera’s AI automation platform — including scalable APIs, data pipelines, and integrations with enterprise systems.

This role is hands-on and ideal for someone who enjoys building distributed systems, solving challenging backend problems, and contributing to architectural discussions in a collaborative, fast-moving team.

Key Responsibilities

Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy).
  • Build reliable microservices that support data processing, automation, and AI system integrations.
  • Implement and optimize database schemas, queries, and caching for performance and scalability.
  • Contribute to data pipelines and synchronization services across enterprise integrations.

AI & Systems Integration

  • Connect backend services with AI model servers, vector databases, and automation workflows.
  • Enable smooth data exchange between AI agents and enterprise systems like Salesforce, SAP, and Workday.

Scalability & Reliability

  • Identify and fix performance bottlenecks in backend code and databases.
  • Implement caching, monitoring, and logging to ensure system reliability and observability.
  • Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and maintain cloud-based services on AWS or GCP.

Security & Quality

  • Implement secure authentication and authorization (OAuth2, RBAC, SSO).
  • Follow best practices in code quality, testing, and documentation.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving backend architecture.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work closely with frontend, AI, and product teams to deliver new features.
  • Take initiative in identifying improvements and building practical, scalable solutions.
  • Balance speed and long-term scalability in a fast-moving environment.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of backend development experience with a focus on APIs, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Proficient in Python, with experience using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL and data modeling best practices.
  • Familiarity with Redis, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub), and asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with cloud storage solutions such as AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage.
  • Understanding of API authentication, security, and scalability principles.
  • Strong debugging, testing, and performance optimization skills.

Bonus Points

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into backend systems.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures or workflow automation systems.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth tech companies.

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.

Compensation Range: $180K - $250K

descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Connexity, a Taboola company, is a data-driven retail performance marketing and commerce platform that helps online retailers acquire new customers and drive incremental sales at a cost that meets their ROI objectives. As the leading independent source of new customers and sales for retailers, we manage the complexities of new customer acquisition on behalf of thousands of retailers. Connexity technology connects merchants like Walmart, Wayfair and Macy's with high-intent shoppers across a vast and complex network of publishers, creators, search and marketplace channels. We joined forces with Taboola in 2021, own ShopYourLikes and Skimlinks, making us the largest, open-web performance platform in the Retail & eCommerce space, generating $5B of GMV/retail sales per year.


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Backend Engineer to join our Internal Tools team. Our team owns the design and implementation of our next-generation internal tools platform — a new advertiser management platform that unifies several legacy systems under a single, modern foundation, with a focus on high-performance middleware and backend services.

You will play a central role in building this platform from the ground up: designing APIs and services, shaping the data model, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable backend systems. Develop APIs, microservices, and other server-side components that power platform features and functionality.
  • Architecture and Design: Contribute to the architecture and design of backend systems. Ensure solutions are reliable, scalable, and performant, and make informed decisions on technology choices and system design.
  • Data Modeling: Design and optimize relational database schemas and queries that serve as the system of record for the platform.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to define and implement new features and improvements.
  • Problem-Solving: Identify and troubleshoot complex technical issues, provide effective solutions, and optimize system performance. Continuously improve and refactor the codebase to enhance scalability and maintainability.
  • Code Quality: Maintain high standards for code quality, including thorough testing, code reviews, and documentation.
  • Innovation: Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies. Evaluate and recommend new tools, frameworks, and libraries — including AI-assisted development tooling — to strengthen our stack and our team's velocity.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 10+ years of professional experience in backend development, with a track record of designing and delivering high-performance systems.
  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in Java is a must. Experience with additional languages (e.g., Python, Node.js, Go) is a plus.
  • Backend Frameworks: Hands-on experience with Spring Boot is a must.
  • API Development: Solid knowledge of RESTful API design, best practices, and implementation.
  • Database Skills: Strong expertise in relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL), including schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about data integrity and consistency. Experience with NoSQL databases or analytical warehouses (e.g., BigQuery) is a plus.
  • System Design: Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system design principles. Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily development workflow — for code generation, refactoring, test writing, and debugging. You should be able to critically evaluate AI-generated code, recognize when it is wrong or subtly unsafe, and take full ownership of everything you ship. Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications or building internal AI-powered tooling is a plus.
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment. Experience working in Agile methodologies.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required.


Voted “Best Places to Work,” our culture is driven by self-starters, team players, and visionaries. Headquartered in Santa Monica, the company operates sites and business services in the US, EMEA, and APAC. We offer top benefits including flexible time off, paid holidays, competitive comp, team events and more!

  • Health Care Plans (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k Matching)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D), LTD & STD
  • Paid Leave Benefits (Maternity, Paternity & Medical)
  • Free Food & Snacks
  • Wellness Resources
  • Equity


We are committed to providing a culture at Connexity that supports the diversity, equity and inclusion of our most valuable asset, our people. We encourage individuality and are driven to represent a workplace that celebrates our differences, and provides opportunities equally across gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and all other demographics. Our actions across Education, Recruitment, Retention, and Volunteering reflect our core company values and remind us that we’re all in this together to drive positive change in our industry.


The pay for this position is $175,000-$200,000 and depends on several factors such as location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We offer many perks as part of the compensation package that include a equity, Flexible Time Off (FTO), medical/dental/vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) match, paid parental leave, and more.


This position is hybrid preferred, with two days per week in our Santa Monica office. Fully remote available depending on location and in the following states: CA, TX, NV, CO, WA

descriptionHtml:
#TeamNextdoor

Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at nextdoor.com.

Meet Your Future Neighbors

As a Software Engineer at Nextdoor, you’ll join a focused team of developers, product managers, and designers who are passionate about using technology to cultivate a kinder world where everyone has a neighbor they can rely on. We are a small, high performing team of engineers that wear multiple hats and prioritize impact for our customers. We care about moving fast and delivering impact, without compromising on quality and reliability as guided by our Engineering Principles. You will have the opportunity to learn from your co-workers and teach them. As a team, we will make each other better and build great software.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London.

The Impact You’ll Make

We believe in empowering our teams to own all aspects of bringing Nextdoor to life. As such, you’ll get the opportunity to make key contributions across our engineering stack - this includes developing and improving frameworks across our frontend and backend services, in addition to making direct contributions to your team’s product area.

In addition to writing code, you’ll have the opportunity to help define the features that we build, through collaboration internally, and in some cases, talking to our customers and members to understand how we can better serve them. You’ll also get the chance to collaborate with product managers and designers to drive Nextdoor forward. We believe engineers should have a stake over all aspects of the product - from coming up with the next big ideas to build, through helping set expectations and plan roadmaps, all the way through understanding the impact of new features through rigorous data analysis. As your career at Nextdoor develops, you’ll also get the chance to grow your role towards what you’re most passionate about.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Backend development in a variety of languages/frameworks including:
    • Python/Django
    • Kotlin / JVM
    • SQL
    • GraphQL
    • Redis
    • Postgres
    • Kafka
    • AWS
  • Collaborating with product management, data science, and design to ensure we build the right things to maximize impact on neighbors.
  • Working with other engineering teams in Toronto, San Francisco and beyond
  • Participate in in-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises
  • Build in-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor’s company culture
What You’ll Bring to The Team

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience
  • Self-starter who thrives in an ambiguous environment and focuses on delivering impact for our neighbors
  • Strong coding abilities in at least one language. Python or Kotlin experience preferred.
  • Experience building and deploying flexible backend systems at scale
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong desire to learn about new technologies and systems
  • Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done

Rewards

Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create one overall rewards package.

The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $165,000 to $250,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. Compensation may also vary by geography.

We also expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date would be within the first 3 months of your start date.

Overall, total compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

We have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of great health plans. We cover 100% of your personal monthly premium for health, dental, and vision – and provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.

At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

For information about our collection and use of applicants’ personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here.

descriptionHtml:
About Read:

Read AI is redefining how teams collaborate by bringing intelligence to every conversation. Our platform improves productivity across meetings, messages, and email and works with the tools teams already use, including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Slack.

We believe meetings should produce clear outcomes—not more content to process. We’re building a product that helps people arrive prepared, participate effectively, understand what happened, follow through on what was decided, and carry the right context forward.

Backed by $81 million from Smash Capital, Madrona, and Goodwater Capital, Read AI is growing quickly. If you want to shape the future of AI-powered collaboration at a product-focused startup, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role:

Read AI is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Backend team. You will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling backend systems that power our AI-driven productivity platform. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, shipping code weekly and directly impacting millions of users.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python (FastAPI), SQLAlchemy, and AWS infrastructure.
  • Build features for data ingestion, third-party integrations (e.g., Slack, HubSpot, Notion), authentication/authorization, and enterprise-grade security and compliance.
  • Own well-scoped features end to end, including design input, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and data scientists to deliver innovative solutions.
  • Contribute to code quality by giving and receiving thoughtful code reviews and following engineering best practices.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and help improve the reliability and observability of backend systems.
  • Identify and implement improvements to system performance, scalability, and reliability as user and data volume grows.
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation, ownership, and customer-centricity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a track record of shipping production code.
  • Proficiency in Python (or similar languages such as Java, C++, or Node.js).
  • Experience building services on cloud platforms (preferably AWS).
  • Solid understanding of API design, plus working knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth2, JWT) and security best practices.
  • Exposure to CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and modern DevOps practices.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work well across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Strong sense of ownership, curiosity, and eagerness to learn and grow.
  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with distributed systems or high-scale data pipelines.

This description reflects Read AI’s focus on rapid iteration, technical excellence, and building robust backend systems to support AI-powered productivity tools for a growing user base.

Why Read AI?

  • Innovative: We’re set to bring AI to the masses by introducing technology designed to improve every interaction.
  • Massive Impact: AI’s greatest impact will be on the ability to allow people to do more, taking away mundane tasks and allowing them to focus on what matters the most.
  • Growth Opportunities: Read AI is the fastest growing AI-copilot and meeting notetaker in history, and is on pace to be one of the fastest growing consumer AI companies in the world, adding more than 1MM new customers every month. The company raised Series A and B in 2024, and was noted as a Top Company To Watch in 2025 by Inc Magazine.
  • Leadership: Learn more about CEO and Co-Founder David Shim in this Fortune Good Life profile from July 2025; CTO and Co-Founder Rob Williams was recently anointed as one of the most disruptive leaders in AI; and Co-Founder and VP Data Science Elliott Waldron goes behind-the-scenes on our patents and models in this tech brief.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a supportive and collaborative environment with a diverse and talented team.

companySlogan: Quo (formerly OpenPhone). The next-generation phone system.
descriptionHtml:
Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big.

About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer at Quo, you will spend a majority of your time coding, architecting, and owning moderate to complex components. Beyond your technical work, you may also lead a small team or a project. You might also spend time providing technical guidance, code reviews, and design and delivering on small/medium size projects end-to-end.

Potential Areas Of Focus Include

  • Leveraging AI and advanced technologies to help customers manage and derive insights from their data, optimizing the customer onboarding experience.
  • Empowering users to independently set up, manage, and scale their accounts with a seamless and compliant process.
  • Enhancing core messaging and calling features, improving customer data management, and optimizing the visibility of conversations and contacts.

In any of these areas, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle impactful challenges and help build scalable backend systems that will support a growing user base.

Technical Stack And Tools

  • Our backend is built on Node using Typescript.
  • We use Kubernetes on AWS to orchestrate our infrastructure setup and deployment.
  • The overall architecture is event-driven microservices with Temporal and RabbitMQ at the center of it.
  • We use a variety of databases for different purposes: Postgres, Mongo, Elastic, and Redis.
  • Observability Tools: Datadog
  • Other Tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, and Slack

About You

  • Strong experience with Typescript, or experience with object-oriented languages such as Java or C# and Javascript/Node.
  • Strong experience with observability tools, including metrics, structured logging and distributed tracing
  • You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of communication. You hold yourself to a high standard and help empower others to do the same.
  • You are intentional about how your work impacts customers, the community, and each other. You practice empathy, generosity, and thoughtfulness as you evaluate tradeoffs in pursuit of the best solution.
  • You are curious. You better seek to understand the ‘why’ behind things, so that you can better plan and build the ‘how’. You support your teammates and customers through the continuous pursuit of knowledge. You’re a lifelong learner.
  • Your code is a pleasure for your teammates to read and understand and you strive to ensure it is readable, testable, and maintainable.. When working in the codebase, you leave things better than you found them.
  • You embrace AI and find ways to use it to improve your work, rather than shying away from it.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $187,000 - $220,000 USD
  • All other US Locations: $169,000 - $198,000 USD
  • Canada: $172,000 - $202,000 CAD

The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

Who we are

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.
